title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding the Bryan East and West campuses, featuring local dining, shopping, and student-friendly services in Lincoln.

cards.title: The Eatery on South 48th
cards.subtitle: South 48th Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this local favorite for a massive menu of comfort food and a dedicated gluten-free selection just blocks from the East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular local restaurant on South 48th Street known for its extensive menu and student-friendly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eatery is located at 2548 South 48th Street, Lincoln, NE, and offers a wide variety of food including gluten-free options.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8:00 AM; closes at 8:30 PM or 9:30 PM depending on the day.

cards.title: Piedmont Shops on Cotner
cards.subtitle: South Cotner Boulevard
cards.notes: Browse locally owned specialty shops and grab a coffee at this renovated mid-century center located directly north of the medical campus.
cards.short_summary: An upscale neighborhood retail center on Cotner Boulevard featuring local boutiques and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shoppes at Piedmont is located at 1265 S. Cotner Street and features locally owned specialty shops and restaurants.
cards.source_title: The Shoppes at Piedmont | Shopping Center Lincoln NE
cards.access_notes: Individual store hours vary; generally open during standard retail hours.

cards.title: The Mill in College View
cards.subtitle: Prescott Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Study with a fresh brew at this neighborhood anchor, a central gathering spot for students in the historic College View district.
cards.short_summary: A beloved local coffee house located in the heart of the College View neighborhood near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mill in College View is located at 4736 Prescott Ave and serves as a community gathering place.
cards.source_title: College View - The Mill Coffee & Tea
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Mon-Thurs) or 7:00 PM (Fri-Sun).

cards.title: Norm's Local Market
cards.subtitle: South 48th Street Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by this family-owned convenience store for fresh breakfast, healthy snacks, and essential groceries near the East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned convenience store on South 48th Street offering fresh food and local products.
cards.evidence_claim: Norm's on 48th is located at 2510 S 48th Street and is described as more than an average convenience store.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and grocery needs.

cards.title: Independence Center Block
cards.subtitle: South 16th Street Corridor
cards.notes: Navigate the West Campus area near this facility, which marks the southern edge of the medical complex on Lake Street.
cards.short_summary: A key facility on the Bryan West Campus located near the intersection of 16th and Lake Streets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryan Independence Center is located at 1640 Lake Street, near the Bryan West Campus at 2300 S. 16th St.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the main West Campus entrance or Lake Street.

cards.title: Residential 52nd Street
cards.subtitle: South 52nd Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk through this quiet, established neighborhood where the main college building is integrated into the local residential fabric.
cards.short_summary: The residential street where the main Bryan College of Health Sciences building is located.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryan College of Health Sciences is located at 1535 S. 52nd Street in a quiet, established, residential neighborhood.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Public residential street with free parking available for college visitors.

cards.title: 48th & O Street Hub
cards.subtitle: O Street Corridor
cards.notes: Access quick dining and major retail services at this busy intersection, a primary commercial hub for students living east of campus.
cards.short_summary: A major commercial intersection near campus featuring popular dining and retail options.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A is located at 4770 O St, Lincoln, NE, at the intersection of 48th and O Streets.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Saturday until 10:00 PM; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Late Night on South 48th
cards.subtitle: South 48th Street Corridor
cards.notes: Find late-night dining options just south of the medical center for those long study sessions or late clinical shifts.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food option on South 48th Street known for late-night hours near the East Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's is located at 2615 South 48th Street and is noted for being open late.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open late; check official site for current closing times.

cards.title: Everett Street Campus Entry
cards.subtitle: Everett Street
cards.notes: Use this specific residential street entrance to access the main Bryan College of Health Sciences building on the East Campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary street-level entrance point for the main college campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The main campus location for Bryan College of Health Sciences is entered at 50th & Everett Streets.
cards.access_notes: Main entry point for students and faculty to the college building.

cards.title: North 48th Retail Block
cards.subtitle: North 48th Street Corridor
cards.notes: Pick up school supplies and pharmacy needs at this major retailer located just a short drive north of the East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A major retail destination on 48th Street providing essential supplies for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Target is located at 333 N 48th St, Lincoln, NE, and includes a CVS pharmacy and Starbucks.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
